The '''medium repeating blaster''' or '''medium repeat blaster''' was the medium powered variant of the [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].

==Description==
The medium repeating blasters were usually mounted on a tripod or defense installations, and were operated by a team of two.<ref name="TRG1" /> These powerful ranged weapons had a fair amount of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] and a medium energy [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]].

==Usage==
These military-only issued blasters were designed to support infantry units. The medium repeating blasters were used by [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] stole the designs near the start of the war, as a desperate attempt at defense.

The Rebels were able to deploy [[Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon]]s during their [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|defense]] of their [[Echo Base/Legends|headquarters]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
